status.description: The status of the custom content.

spaceId.description: ID of the containing space (must be the same as the spaceId of the space the custom content was created in).

blogPostId.description: ID of the containing Blog Post.

customContentId.description: ID of the containing custom content.

number.description: The version number, must be incremented by one.

message.description: An optional message to be stored with the version.
